title: Port-convention population waves (waves.toml)
description: The batches sync_port_conventions.py is allowed to write. A board not listed in any wave is skipped by the trust gate even when its row is otherwise verified, so this file is the deliberate scope control on mechanical population.

description.description: Scope and rationale, including which listed boards are held back and why.

boards.description: Registry board-row names. Every entry must resolve to a real row (checked by the validator).
